verdict.rationale: Dynadot's security page documents an "optional Registry Lock" for domains that must never move, plus an "account lock". However, nothing shows a domain-level transfer lock applied by default, and account lock is not clearly the same thing as a registrar transfer lock. missing for 10: evidence of a transfer lock enabled by default on domains, detail on how Registry Lock works (eligible TLDs, unlock procedure), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, my domains can be locked down — transfer lock by default and a registry-lock option for the domains that must never move

citations.quote: Dynadot offers free domain privacy, account lock, two-factor authentication, and optional Registry Lock to keep your online assets safe.
